name: Start Webserver Noauth Architecture
description: Architecture for the make start-webserver-noauth target, covering the nginx-only local static stack and the setup helpers that prepare the HTTP endpoint on port 8080.

nodes.name: Architect
nodes.description: A human architect or operator who starts the noauth local stack, follows the host announcement from the startup flow, and requests the repository's static CALM assets over HTTP.

nodes.name: CALM CLI
nodes.description: The CALM CLI process invoked by the startup flow, including its use of scripts/detect_public_host.py to resolve the local host name or IP exported as CALM_PUBLIC_HOST before the noauth nginx container is started.

nodes.name: Noauth Nginx Config
nodes.description: The infra/nginx/nginx.noauth.conf file mounted into the nginx container to expose the static tree and anonymous /healthz endpoint over HTTP on port 8080.

nodes.name: HTTP Static Content Tree
nodes.description: The static_http content tree mounted directly into nginx so architecture JSON, patterns, standards, controls, and related documentation are served from the local repository.

nodes.name: Nginx Static Web Server
nodes.description: The nginx Compose service started by make start-webserver-noauth, serving the repository's static content over plain HTTP on port 8080 without oauth2-proxy or Keycloak.

nodes.name: MY-CALM.REPO
nodes.description: A container grouping representing the local MY-CALM.REPO runtime started by the noauth target.

relationships.description: Architects run the CALM CLI startup flow to discover which local host will be advertised for the noauth endpoint before nginx is started.
The CALM CLI supplies the detected CALM_PUBLIC_HOST value to the nginx startup flow and the host narrative announced for the local HTTP endpoint.
The nginx container loads the noauth nginx configuration that exposes repository assets and keeps /healthz anonymously available.
The nginx server serves static repository assets from the mounted static_http content tree.
The noauth docker-compose startup groups the nginx service together with the mounted static content and nginx configuration used by that service.
